summary: The candidate is mathematically correct and complete. The positive integer weights and bounded signed digits identify the entire upper face of the original weighted simplex support. Its stated layers are exhaustive, their convex hull has the original all-ones vector in its relative interior, and hence they form the minimal face. The root exists uniquely in the stated interval, the layer normalization and every original coordinate mean are exact, and the relative-entropy argument establishes the unique maximum-entropy law. The conditional score means on the two outer layers give the claimed quadratic variance lower bound and its unbounded ratio to the original dimension. The smallest case r=1 and all layer boundaries introduce no exception.
